evals.prompt: I want to delete a single word from a list. Add the endpoint and wire it up from backend to frontend.
evals.expected_output: DELETE /api/lists/{listId}/words/{wordId} authorized; ownership check (user owns the list); WordService.DeleteAsync in back/Services/; service registered scoped in Program.cs; back/README.md row added (or file created with endpoint table); deleteWord method added to front/src/services/list.ts (or a new word.ts) returning the proper type.

evals.prompt: Add an endpoint that returns all vocab lists owned by a given user (by user id). No auth — anyone can see anyone's lists for now.
evals.expected_output: GET /api/users/{id}/lists, no [Authorize], VocabListService.GetByUserAsync returning ListResponse[] (or empty list when user has none); DI registration if VocabListService didn't exist; README row added; getListsByUser method in front/src/services/list.ts or user.ts; types.ts unchanged (uses existing List interface).

evals.prompt: Let me rename an existing vocab list. PATCH /api/lists/{id} with a new name.
evals.expected_output: PATCH /api/lists/{id} authorized; RenameListRequest DTO; VocabListService.RenameAsync with ownership check + empty-name validation; service registered scoped; README row added; renameList method in front/src/services/list.ts returning the updated List; no new types needed.
